description.value:
Duration constant

Your unarmed attacks gain the versatile B/P/S trait and their damage die increases by one step. Improvised weapons in your hands lose the improvised penalty entirely and count as martial weapons of the closest matching group for all your Deadhand abilities, including The Answer and your Trade's weapon fluency.

cinderfall.incomplete: The trait grant and damage-die-step-up on the caster's own unarmed attacks are confirmed real via pf2e-source/src/module/rules/rule-element/item-alteration/handlers.ts: property "traits" (mode add) and property "damage-dice-faces" (mode upgrade, itemType weapon) are both real, schema-confirmed ItemAlteration properties. "Improvised weapons count as martial weapons of the closest matching group" is unbuilt: the "group" ItemAlteration property (handlers.ts:580) only accepts mode:"override" to a single fixed literal weapon group chosen at authoring time -- it cannot express a per-item "closest matching" computation across arbitrary improvised weapons.
